apps.localizedDescription:
v1.3.3 Build 26 — 修复 SideStore / AltStore 个人免费 Apple ID 安装失败 (#6) | Fix SideStore / AltStore App ID Registration:
1. 修复使用 SideStore / AltStore 个人免费签安装时因 `CFBundleDisplayName` 含中文及空格导致 `An invalid value '开幕 Camlo' was provided for the parameter 'appIdName'` 报错的问题：将主 `Info.plist` 顶层 `CFBundleDisplayName` 与 `apps.json` `name` 统一调整为纯英文 ASCII 标识 `Camlo`，并通过 `InfoPlist.xcstrings`（`zh-Hans.lproj/InfoPlist.strings`）本地化保留简体中文系统桌面显示名称「开幕 Camlo」；
   (Fix SideStore / AltStore Free Apple ID `appIdName` Error (#6): sets the top-level `Info.plist` `CFBundleDisplayName` and `apps.json` `name` to pure ASCII `Camlo` so Apple's `addAppId` endpoint succeeds reliably, while preserving the localized Chinese Home Screen label `开幕 Camlo` via `InfoPlist.xcstrings`.)
2. 完整包含 `v1.3.2` iPhone Duo 折叠屏 `retinaMultiplier` 与内屏偏移修复、10 套原创「次元 3D」二次元交互包与金库旧包自动原地自愈。
   (Includes all `v1.3.2` iPhone Duo scaling/centering fixes, 10 official 3D Anime packs, and automatic Vault self-healing.)
